title: gluedown 1.1.0
text: Fix md_code() vectorization bug: double-backtick escaping applied elements whenever element contained backtick. Now element escaped independently (#38). Fix md_setext() width = FALSE: previously behaved identically width = TRUE due min(FALSE) < 1 evaluating TRUE (#37). Fix md_issue() emitting one warning per element instead elements missing "user/repo" format (#36). Remove mockr suggested dependencies; mocking now uses testthat::local_mocked_bindings() (#34). Fix md_code() normalize newlines spaces within code spans, per CommonMark spec. Fix md_fence() trim leading/trailing whitespace info string, per CommonMark 0.29 spec. Tilde fences now also error info string contains tilde character (backtick fences already enforced ). Fix md_setext() auto-width measure trimmed content, leading/trailing whitespace heading text inflate underline length. Add method argument md_hardline(): "backslash" produces backslash hard line break (foo\) alternative default two-trailing-spaces form. Add collapsed reference link support md_label(): omitting label now produces [text][], resolves matching md_reference(). Add wrap argument md_link() md_image(): wrap = TRUE wraps destination angle brackets (<url>), required URL contains spaces.
